name: Mikagura Naomi
source:
A female teacher who has been assigned to the school where the story takes place.

After graduating from college, she married her boyfriend, but her husband, a trading company employee, left for a long-term assignment in Los Angeles after their second year of marriage, and she now lives alone.

She was completely naïve about sex, but her experiences with her husband have blossomed her body into a highly sensitive one.

When she is assigned to her current school, the sadistic protagonist discovers her desire to be abused, of which she was unaware, and forces her into servitude.
